content.title: How to watch Suns vs. Thunder: First Round Game 1 TV channel and streaming options for April 19
content.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder will face the Phoenix Suns in Game 1 of the opening round of the NBA Playoffs.How to watch Phoenix Suns vs. Oklahoma City Thunder Venue: Paycom Center Time: 3:30 p.m. ET TV: ABC Streaming (in-market viewers): Fubo (try for free) Streaming (out-of-market viewers): NBA League Pass Watching in person?
